scope: Read-only source audit of learner language/assistance, offline draft preparation, snapshots and retained exports. No app edits, compilation, tests, Worker/browser/network, SQL or provider work.

findings.title: Retained-learning export pairs an own saved enrollment with an unrelated default cohort
findings.trigger: Own active older enrollment has an unavailable exact source. Its cohort is not content-open; another cohort for the same program remains open with a different exact pin. Open the saved pathway and select Export my retained learning.

source.fact: With own enrollment e present, selectPreviewCohort is invoked with undefined intent and its default first-open cohort becomes selectedCohort.
Undefined intent chooses the first content-open/open cohort, independent of the enrollment cohortId and saved pin.
The correctly unavailable own saved edition renders a download that serializes enrollment:e together with cohort:selectedCohort.

findings.impact: The download contains the preserved older enrollment and the different newer cohort/pin. A learner or support reviewer can misread the file as the saved enrollment belonging to the newer cohort. No persisted mutation, pin upgrade, authority change or cross-account data leak is established.
findings.boundedFix: For an own-enrollment export, include only the current accepted cohort matching e.cohortId and the exact full pinnedRef; use null if missing, mismatched or unverifiable. Alternatively omit cohort for own enrollment. Never attach the default/new-offering selection to own saved history. Leave course resolution, enrollment commands and source authority unchanged.
pureAcceptance: Use actual selectPreviewCohort, pinnedRef/contentKey and current export projection (or a small pure export read model). Construct older own enrollment plus two same-program cohorts, older contentOpen=false and newer open, and only the newer source resolvable.

Assert the current default selection resolves to newer, yet retained export enrollment equals the older original byte-for-byte and exported cohort is null or exactly the own cohort with identical pin.

Cover reordered cohorts, cohort removal/repointing, malformed own pin, personal no-cohort enrollment, exact matching own cohort and un-enrolled explicit unavailable offering. Assert inputs unchanged. Disable fetch in the pure suite.
readOnlyBrowserAcceptance: Reuse the already accepted M5 memory-only GET display case named unavailable own active older pin takes precedence over a present revised offering; do not create or update fixtures.

Click Export my retained learning, capture its local download, parse JSON and assert exact saved own enrollment plus only matching own cohort or null; assert no newer cohort/pin/title appears as attached cohort.
Retain corrected same-origin GET/HEAD routing guards and redirect refusal, compare actual API state/revision before and after, and report this separately from mutating command/CAS acceptance.
findings.verificationStatus: Independent source diagnosis only; no pure tests, download or browser run executed by reviewer.

otherConclusions: Language requests are explicitly disclosed as requests, not translations; saved pin and progress are retained. Read-aloud uses browser-reported local voices with own lesson/pin/account/workspace cleanup.
Human response capture requires explicit consent/readback/own-reasoning declaration and rechecks fields, exact pin and policy before the separate existing submission.

Offline drafts remain personal-lab-only, bounded and unsent; sealing is explicit; unlock/save compare current accepted own context, generation and exact fields. Device-time expiry and cold offline limits are disclosed.
Private snapshot export binds subject and carried checksum; inspection does not import state or confer issuer authority. No further actionable source defect was established in this bounded audit.
